overview: Connecting RV Road to Bommasandra, the upcoming Yellow Line is designed to link south-central residential neighborhoods directly to Electronic City, Bengaluru's massive technology manufacturing hub.
topology_desc: Navigate the route to Electronic City. The Yellow Line serves as the tech corridor backbone, linking south-central transit junctions directly to manufacturing districts.

overview_sections.title: Interchange Connectivity
overview_sections.content:
The Yellow Line will connect with other key routes:

  • RV Road → Interchange with Green Line
  • Silk Board → Future interchange with Blue Line

overview_sections.title: Infrastructure & Technology
overview_sections.content:
• Driverless train capability (GoA4)
  • State-of-the-art CBTC signaling
  • Elevated viaducts and high-capacity coaches

overview_sections.title: Key Areas Covered
overview_sections.content:
Major locations covered include:

  • RV Road
  • BTM Layout
  • Silk Board
  • HSR Layout
  • Electronic City
  • Bommasandra

overview_sections.title: Timings & Frequency
overview_sections.content:
• Planned Operating Hours: 5:30 AM to 11:00 PM
  • Planned Peak Frequency: ~6 minutes
  • Estimated End-to-End Travel Time: ~35 minutes

overview_sections.title: Nearby Attractions
overview_sections.content:
• BTM Lake Park
  • Forum Mall Koramangala
  • Electronic City IT Parks

Rashtreeya Vidyalaya Road.desc: Connects Yellow Line with the Green Line for seamless transfers between southern lines.

Central Silk Board.desc: Upcoming mega interchange station connecting the Yellow Line with Blue Line bus and rail networks.
